- **Auth:** A new context with no credentials opens `/studio-lab`, and `localStorage.auth_user` is null. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no `audio[src]` elements. `GET /api/studio-token` returns 401, so premium access is not bypassed. The journey matches too: 3 clips at 512/1152/1792, and the fourth placed at 00:48.000 "(nearest free spot)". Q1–Q6 each have a default, and Q4 says hiding or rewording the button needs Saba's permission. I only spot-checked the RT-CAUSE sources and did not open every cited line.
